findings.correction: By the time I finished reading them all and sorting through my thoughts, more than ten minutes had passed.
findings.current: By the time I finished reading them all and整理 my thoughts, more than ten minutes had passed.
findings.defect: Untranslated CJK 整理 remains in the English reading copy in place of 정리.
findings.rationale: The source is ordinary narration (organize/sort one’s thoughts after reading the messages). The draft is not English-only and leaves the verb unfinished.
findings.source: 메시지를 다 읽고 생각을 정리했을 때는 십여 분이 훌쩍 흐른 뒤였다.

findings.correction: But if you asked whether it was enough that I’d mix it into my spear technique without realizing it, the answer was no.
findings.current: But was it really enough to make me unconsciously mix it into my spear technique?
findings.defect: The self-answered negation 물어보면 그건 아니다 is omitted, so an explicit no becomes an unanswered question.
findings.rationale: He denies that half a day of footwork would leak into the spear forms; that denial is the hinge for the next line about seven years of mixed movement.
findings.source: 하지만 창법을 펼칠 때 나도 모르게 섞어 쓸 정도냐, 물어보면 그건 아니다.

findings.correction: Three, two, one. It’s not even a countdown. What is this?
findings.current: Three, two, one. What is this, a countdown?
findings.defect: Omits the negation 카운트 세는 것도 아니고, so the joke becomes a straight identification as a countdown.
findings.rationale: The punchline is that the 3–2–1 Mastery drop looks like a countdown but isn’t one, so the situation is even more absurd.
findings.source: 삼, 이, 일. 카운트 세는 것도 아니고 뭐야, 이게?

findings.correction: Goblin shit might actually taste better… but it was definitely worth a try.
findings.current: Actually, goblin shit might taste better…
findings.defect: Drops the closing judgment 확실히 시도해 볼 만한 일이다 that licenses the second pill.
findings.rationale: The source turns the gag into a decision to test stacking; the draft keeps only the taste aside.
findings.source: 왠지 고블린 똥이 더 맛있을 것 같긴 한데…… 확실히 시도해 볼 만한 일이다.

findings.correction: I needed to shout my head off and take a proof photo. I needed to flatten Big Brother Jinho’s nose—he used to tease me for being a rice bug.
findings.current: I needed to shout until my voice gave out and take a picture to prove it. I needed to make Big Brother Jinho, who used to tease me for being a rice bug, eat his words.
findings.defect: 떠나가라 is volume, not voice failure; 쌀벌레 is an opaque leftover; 코를 납작하게 is humbling, not retracting a claim.
findings.rationale: The beat is loud bragging plus humiliating the older friend who called him a freeloading rice-eater, not making him withdraw a statement after going hoarse.
findings.source: 떠나가라 소리를 지르고, 인증 사진도 찍어야 하는데. 쌀벌레라고 놀리던 진호 형 코를 납작하게 만들어 줘야 하는데.

findings.correction: You have realized the connection between martial arts on your own.
findings.current: You have discovered the connection between martial arts on your own.
findings.defect: System 깨달았습니다 is insight/realization, not discovery of an object.
findings.rationale: The bound term is enlightenment/insight; later narration already uses insight for 깨달음, but the panel itself downgrades the mechanism to discovering.

summary: One major English-copy break (CJK leftover for 정리). Several omitted negations and a dropped decision beat; remaining issues are local register/idiom losses, not scene reversals.
